The '''Duelist Elite''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model built by [[Trang Robotics]]. These droids were considered "top-of-the-line" during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darths]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]], [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]], and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] used them in [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] to [[Training droid/Legends|train]] for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].

==Characteristics==
Duelist Elites had long [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] with swiveling joints that allowed them to have a wide range of motion. The internal [[Gyroscopic stabilizer|gyroscope]] provided the droid with superior balance. The droids were masters of the three classical fencing styles of foil, épée, and saber. They could be equipped with a variety of melee weapons; including [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]], and lightsabers.<ref name="EGD" />

A new one cost 275,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EGD" />

Factory-equipped Duelist Elites were equipped with inhibitors that would prevent them from dealing a death blow to a beaten opponent, which the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] disabled for their sparring and [[Sith training|training]].

==History==
[[File:Rapier-SWDM1.png|thumb|left|250px|Rapier, one of Maul's Duelist Elite droids.]]
Darth Maul was known to have sparred against [[Rapier (droid)|Rapier]], [[Hachete (droid)|Hachete]], [[Cudgel (droid)|Cudgel]], and [[Chain (droid)|Chain]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] owned several of these droids, but since they were no match for him, he tended to use modified [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP droids]] instead.

State-of-the-art Duelist Elite [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]] with [[flexisteel]] [[saber]]s and [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulators]] were employed to guard the ''[[Sun Runner]]'' [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit ship]] fabricated in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-foiled attempt to destroy the orbital [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]. The droids were reduced to smoldering scrap, however, by 18-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] before he destroyed the false ''Sun Runner'' itself with a [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]]-planted [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]].<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>

The pirate [[Raskar]] utilized a Duelist Elite as a sparring droid. He also modified it to act as a security guard in the event of a breakin, as Han Solo discovered when breaking into his villa to retrieve Raskar's [[power gem]]. However, Solo tricked the droid into charging into destruct beams surrounding the power gem and destroyed it, consequently also causing Raskar to believe Solo died until he returned to the Villa.<ref name="TPG">"[[The Power Gem]]"</ref>
